before.rappels: Descend via double-rope rappels down the route line; fixed slings/bolts exist but are reported worn or rockfall-damaged in places — inspect every anchor.
before.descent: Downclimb via the same line, or descend via nearby gullies to regain the talus. Single rappels may be used on steeper sections. Careful route-finding essential for descent.
before.descent_text: Retrace the route or descend via adjacent gully systems to the talus. Rappels (single 40-50 ft pitches) can speed descent but require carefully placed anchors in natural features or existing bolts if present.
gear: Trad rack (single set micronuts to #2 Camalot)

before.rope_note: Presumed short trad route on Index Town Wall granite (Obelisk/Madsen's Ledge area); standard 60m rope to lower/rappel.

before.descent_text: From the top of the wall, a fixed rap tree (60 m rope reported as of Sep 2019) allows a single-rope rappel — inspect any fixed gear before trusting it due to reported pika damage at anchors. Alternatively, descend the scree slope, using the full rope length as a handline/backup if downclimbing.
before.overview: Prey climbs a 5-pitch (510 ft), mostly-bolted line up corners, roofs, and an arete on the right side of Osprey Wall on quality white marbled rock, culminating in a celebrated 5.10c "money pitch."
